scope: VB control-array repeated-instance lifetime for the existing exact graphical CheckBox/OptionButton renderer path.

actual_source_basis.vb5: MouseHook.frm contains OptionButton optTest indexes 0 and 1, plus indexed graphical CommandButton controls.
actual_source_basis.vb6: MouseHook6.frm contains the matching OptionButton optTest indexes 0 and 1 and indexed graphical CommandButton controls.
actual_source_basis.meaning: VB array indexes map to distinct runtime-created HWND instances; no shared renderer state or image/font ownership may be inferred from the common control name.

native_contract: The existing project-authored exact-runtime fixture creates three same-class graphical CheckBox instances with separate child IDs, assigns distinct BM_GETCHECK values, destroys the middle instance, recreates the same ID, and explicitly retires one sibling.
coverage: A destroyed sibling leaves the two surviving windows' public values intact; the recreated HWND independently attaches when injected; removing one renderer attachment does not remove its siblings. This supplements the existing option-group test without treating a C fixture as an arbitrary VB runtime proof.
product_change: none; renderer already owns state per HWND. Only a C17 regression test and source receipt changed.
